### Images

For amd64 and arm64, published by the release workflow a few minutes after this release: `ghcr.io/maxgfr/troupe`, `troupe-renderer`, `troupe-ollama`, `troupe-web` and `troupe-cli`, each tagged `<%= nextRelease.version %>`. To run this version, set `TROUPE_VERSION=<%= nextRelease.version %>` in `.env` ([SELF-HOSTING.md](https://github.com/maxgfr/troupe/blob/<%= nextRelease.gitTag %>/docs/SELF-HOSTING.md)).
